verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's evidence shows only adjacent features. Check-ins track pings from cron jobs the user schedules elsewhere, and uptime checks and alarms evaluate on their own terms. None of this documents a way to create and schedule the user's own recurring jobs or workflows in Honeybadger. Recurring automation is a fair question for a monitoring SaaS, so the axis applies, but the capability is absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
